text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an adolescent presenting with delayed menarche and a history of bone fragility; to understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any unusual physical features like short stature, wide ribs, or a "fish-mouth" appearance on a dental X-ray? speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency.
